HVAC is a good trade, more so on the controls side. If you are open to any trade I would suggest becoming an electrician. It is the best trade, and the hardest theory wise. Get into a non-union apprenticeship program; you work for four years and go to trade school at night to get your journeyman's license, then two more years to get your masters. At that point you should be skilled in control work and can switch to HVAC if you want. I say non-union because you will get more experience and more responsibility quicker in a smaller shop. Your prospects will greatly improve by getting a trade.
